sources.name: CMHC Residential Mortgage Industry Report, Fall 2026
TRREB Historic Statistics — annual sales and average price
TRREB Market Watch — latest report and coverage-change notice

groups.title: Provincial mortgage arrears
groups.note: 90+ days overdue. CBA-member bank mortgages; share of mortgage accounts. Ontario is a province, not the Toronto CMA or GTHA. Quarterly figures are kept separate from the monthly forecast table.

groups.title: Mortgage arrears by lender type
groups.note: Canada-wide reported 90+ day delinquency rates. Lender populations and source coverage differ. MIEs include mortgage investment corporations and other private entities; this is not the GTHA balance-weighted series.
groups.source: CMHC; regulatory reporting, Statistics Canada and CBA, Figure 7

groups.title: Private-lender stress in the GTHA
groups.note: Mortgage investment entities (MIEs), 90+ days overdue, weighted by outstanding mortgage balance. 11.14% of balances does not mean one in nine loans. GTHA includes Hamilton; rest of Canada excludes the GTHA.
groups.source: CMHC; Statistics Canada Survey of Non-Bank Mortgage Lenders, Figure 8

groups.title: Other household credit delinquencies
groups.note: Canada-wide 90+ day delinquency rates across consumers, not just mortgage holders. LOC = line of credit; HELOC = home equity line of credit.

groups.title: Monthly arrears and CMHC outlook
groups.note: Fall 2026 forecast vintage. Solid lines are observed; dashed lines are forecasts, not outcomes. The forecast horizon is not a prediction of when house prices will bottom. Monthly observations differ from quarterly averages.

groups.title: Toronto-area monthly sale prices
groups.source: Toronto Regional Real Estate Board, Market Watch monthly tables
groups.note: Nominal average sale price, not a quality-adjusted HPI and not seasonally adjusted. Legacy reports (2020–2023) and expanded board coverage (2024 onward) are separate lines. Sales mix, market boundaries and revisions affect comparisons; do not calculate a cross-break return.

groups.title: Toronto-area annual sale prices
groups.source: Toronto Regional Real Estate Board, Historic Statistics
groups.note: Nominal annual average sale price. TRREB warns that its market area changes over time and history is revised. Annual averages hide within-year troughs, including the 2008–2009 downturn. These prices cannot establish a precise arrears-to-price-bottom lag.

gaps.detail: No verified, consistently defined public historical series has been obtained. The reported 600+ figure is excluded.
Available in individual TRREB monthly reports, but a consistent historical series has not yet been assembled. The roughly 26,000 figure is not plotted as a time series.
This version uses TRREB average prices. A consistently revised monthly benchmark series is still needed for a stronger cycle-timing study.
